children: Brazil's Senate on Thursday approved the main text of a bill backed by President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's administration that includes spending-containment measures and revenue-raising provisions aimed at ensuring compliance with fiscal targets.

Senators still need to vote on amendments to the bill next week. Lula's economic team considers the package essential to meeting next year's fiscal target while accommodating campaign spending pledges by the leftist incumbent, who was reelected in October.
